verdict.rationale: NetHunt's pricing page documents a merge capability covering contacts, companies, and deals, which delivers the core merge part of the story. Nothing in the evidence describes how duplicates are found, or whether merging preserves every field, note, and activity. missing for 10: documented duplicate detection or flagging, evidence of field-level conflict resolution and data preservation during merge, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can detect duplicate contacts or companies and merge them without losing data

citations.quote: Get rid of duplicates by merging several contacts, companies, or deals.
